description: This file defines the NetworkManager plugin class, which exposes network management APIs over COM-RPC and JSON-RPC, including notification handling, interface management, and caching of IP addresses.

classes.name: NetworkManager
classes.description: Main plugin class providing network management functionalities and RPC interface.

classes.name: Notification
classes.description: Inner class handling network and connection notifications for the NetworkManager plugin.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the given service shell.

methods.name: PublicIPAddress
methods.description: Returns the current public IP address.

methods.name: NetworkType
methods.description: Returns the network type (IPv4, IPv6, or unknown).
